meta.title: Usage hub
meta.description: Adds two usage readings under the composer — the DeepSeek API balance and the OpenCode Go allowance — and one panel with the detail. DeepSeek is read from GET /user/balance with the credential named by deepseek.apiKeyEnv (the harness credential store first, then the process environment). OpenCode Go is read from the gateway's /zen/go/v1/usage with the opencode-go API key by default, so no OpenCode app is needed; setting opencode.mode to server instead asks a local OpenCode server, which also reports the Console workspace and budgets. Click a reading to open the panel, which shows the balance breakdown, the rolling, weekly and monthly allowance bars with their reset times, and a Refresh button. The snapshot is cached for 5 minutes (cacheTtlMs) and both providers are read over the network on refresh; turning the bundle off removes the readings and stops both reads.
